calculation_handling.description: Enacting instruction that deletes several 900.2.10 exceptions and replaces the prevailing by-law list of exception 912; no regulation of its own.

Replacement list of prevailing by-laws and sections for exception 912, further deletions and replacements in other 900.2.10 exceptions, and transitional provisions saving applications filed on or before February 7, 2024.

900.2.10(912)@63-2024.explanation: Replaces the list of prevailing by-laws and sections for exception 912 and removes or edits several other site specific exceptions. It also protects buildings and structures covered by a building permit, rezoning, minor variance or site plan application filed on or before February 7, 2024.
